scope: UI source verification only; no skin/native/script/workflow modifications
integration_requirements: Exact installed skin export including addon.xml, active XML/includes/fonts/themes/media; reconcile SHA256 before editing.
Exact installed Health Center source/publication contract; existing labels do not prove freshness or verified healthy state.
Installed Umbrella/other provider menu entry points before attributing custom dialog ownership.
Verified backend watched identity/state/actions before activating new checkmarks or actions.
Physical Fold runtime control bounds, touch/focus/Back, provider actions, all postures and theme acceptance.
Comparable timing/memory observations and 60-120 minute device session; no performance claim from source checks.
validation_limits: Reference XML parsing and source ownership only. No actual UI repair, rendered-after evidence, device testing, native compilation, performance measurement, or release acceptance.
required_source_export: Kodi Health Center > Infinity Skin Export: export the installed skin package. Code-only is sufficient; saved settings/userdata are not required. Exact Health/provider code exports may be needed for their contracts.
